subject: Observability vendor renewals — dual-sourcing & retention options
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lopez <sarah.lopez@datadog.com>, Grafana Sales <sales@grafana.com>, Evan Lee <evan@getsentry.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T09:12:00Z
Subject: Observability vendor renewals — dual-sourcing & retention options

Hi all,

Redwood's contracts for Datadog (infra + logs) and Grafana Cloud (metrics/alerts) are both up for renewal in Q4. We're evaluating a dual-sourcing approach: keep Datadog for traces/host metrics + SSO integrations, and migrate long-tail logs to Grafana Cloud (or S3 archival) to reduce retention costs. We also want to re-evaluate Sentry for error sampling tiers.

Ask: can each vendor provide an updated commercial proposal that covers the items below? Please attach a short price brief and any standard contract redlines you require.

- 12/24 month price options, with committed spend tiers and any startup/expansion credits
- Log retention add-on costs (30/90/365 day tiers) and per-GB egress/restore fees
- Recommended sampling/ingestion controls to hit 40% token/volume reduction with minimal signal loss
- SOC2 / ISO evidence path, SSO provisioning window, and support SLA options
- Any migration assistance credits or onboarding discounts (eg. data transfer, runbooks)

I've attached our current usage inventory so you can map to our baseline. Internal recipients: Lauren (procurement) and Naomi (observability lead) will review proposals. Vivek is the infra owner for cross-region routing constraints.

Please send materials by EOD Aug 6 so we can present options to Finance the week of Aug 10.

Thanks,
Aditya
Aditya Rao
Head of Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment: inventory-usage.csv (CSV with 6 months of ingestion/retention by service)

From: Sarah Lopez <sarah.lopez@datadog.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T14:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Observability vendor renewals — dual-sourcing & retention options

Hi Aditya — thanks for the clear brief. Quick summary from Datadog's side: we've put together a short proposal that maps your CSV to our tiered pricing and included a couple of optimization levers (ingestion filtering and log rehydration credits) that can materially reduce cost. Please find the attachment.

Highlights:
- 12mo committed discount: 12% overall vs pay-as-you-go; 24mo: 18%
- Logs: $0.18/GB ingest, retention add-on: $0.01/GB/day for >90 days (volume discounts apply)
- One-time migration credit: up to $25k (applies if you commit to >=$150k ARR)
- Support: standard business SLA; enterprise SLA and named CSM available at +$15k/year

Questions for you:
1) Can you confirm whether cross-region replication (EU fallback) is a hard requirement? Vivek is copied.
2) For SSO, do you prefer SCIM provisioning or manual SAML setups?

I'll attach the proposal PDF and a short spreadsheet mapping to your usage.

Best,
Sarah Lopez
Enterprise Sales, Datadog

Attachment: ddog-proposal-20260803.pdf

On Mon, Aug 2, 2026 at 09:12 AM Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com> wrote:
> (original message quoted)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Sarah Lopez <sarah.lopez@datadog.com>, Grafana Sales <sales@grafana.com>, Evan Lee <evan@getsentry.com>
Date: 2026-08-05T11:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Observability vendor renewals — dual-sourcing & retention options

Lauren / Naomi — I got Datadog's proposal (attached). Key takeaways: the migration credit is conditional on ARR commit levels; their long-retention per-GB/day is competitive but egress/restore costs need to be clarified. They also asked about cross-region replication — Vivek, can you confirm whether EU fallback is required for logs or just for metrics/traces?

Next steps I'm proposing:
- Request equivalent pricing from Grafana for a logs-tier (they listed logs beta previously) and confirm Sentry sampling/volume terms.
- Run a short TCO worksheet comparing: keep-all-in-Datadog vs migrate long-tail logs to Grafana Cloud + S3 archival. I've started a procurement spreadsheet in Drive (link below).
- Legal should start a parallel redline review if any vendor is materially preferred.

If you approve, I'll push vendors for final commercials by EOD Aug 6 so Finance can model the numbers.

Thanks,
Aditya

Link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=obs-renewal-2026

> On Tue, Aug 3, 2026 at 14:05 Sarah Lopez <sarah.lopez@datadog.com> wrote:
> > (Datadog proposal attached)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-09T15:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Observability vendor renewals — dual-sourcing & retention options

Thanks Aditya — approve proceeding with dual-sourcing evaluation. Two operational notes:

1) Procurement prefers not to accept conditional credits that require sweeping ARR commitments. If Datadog wants to make the migration credit unconditional we should negotiate it into contract as a limited, one-time credit tied to migration milestones.

2) Legal: please open a redline request ticket and loop in Legal (legal@redwood.com). Naomi, please prepare a short risk memo (2 slides) comparing the operational impact of splitting logs vs keeping a single vendor (inc. restore SLAs).

I'll create a Jira ticket for approvals and attach the procurement workbook.

-Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: procurement-summary.xlsx
